image_description: A black and white close-up photograph of a cluster of figs resting on a wooden surface. The image features approximately six visible figs, with one prominent fig in the foreground showing a smooth, pear-shaped body and a distinct stem end (ostiole). The lighting creates soft highlights on the skin, emphasizing the matte texture. The background consists of blurred wooden planks.
